from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper from the collection: its title and which provided papers it cites."""
    paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of the current paper being parsed")
    cited_paper_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the papers found in this document's bibliography that match other papers in the collection")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all CitationRecords from the collection."""
    citation_records: list[CitationRecord]
